drills.title: Tight Turns Around One Cone
drills.instructions:
Setup: Place one cone in the middle of the practice space and leave room to dribble around it.
Dribble close around the cone using inside and outside touches from both feet. Complete one 20-second round in each direction.
Focus: Keep the ball within one step.

drills.title: Two-Cone Inside–Outside Weave
drills.instructions:
Setup: Place two cones about one yard apart, with a little space around them.
Weave around both cones using inside and outside touches. Go through and back three times, using one foot on the way out and the other on the return; switch the starting foot for the next trip.
Focus: Use quick, accurate touches without letting the ball run away.
